<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary standoff:</strong> The Congress party has accused the Centre of delaying the prorogation of the Parliament session to potentially push through the controversial Delimitation Bill.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election integrity:</strong> Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar has assured that all complaints regarding voter name deletions will be resolved before the next Lok Sabha elections.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">

  <li><strong>International legal issues:</strong> An Indian national has been charged in the United States for fraudulently claiming citizenship to participate in the 2024 general election.</li>
</ul>
